fullFlightCoverageFixture.description: Existing liquid placed on ballistic trajectories with breakup history integrated along each trajectory; not a steady-state fluid simulation.

liveMaximumJet.description: 1240 actual GPU liquid steps and GPU fine-particle advances; default resolution, central jet at maximum, side jets off.
liveMaximumJet.note: Sparse impact-ejected outliers rise beyond the main ballistic crest; the test records them rather than assuming height alone measures turbulence. No realtime performance claim.

limits: 32768 fine markers; CPU emission accounting; GPU advection/collision/lifetime; unresolved breakup model, not a two-phase solver.
